title: Standing Up Adventure
welcome_lead: What to do when bullying happens — to you or others. 💪
meta_desc: Friendship & Bullying Adventure 3 — KS3 Psychology on responding to bullying.
final_note: You learned safe, smart responses to bullying.

concepts.def: Someone who steps in to help

walkthroughs.body_html:
Steps that help:

  • Tell someone — adult, friend.
  • Save evidence — screenshots.
  • Block the bully online.
  • Don't reply when angry.

You did not cause this. 💙

Be an upstander, not a bystander:

  • Walk over and talk to the target.
  • Pull them away from the bully.
  • Report what you saw.

Even small actions help.

Bullying hurts long after it stops.

Build resilience:

  • Stay connected to good people.
  • Get back into hobbies.
  • Talk it out — counsellor, helpline.

UK helpline Childline: 0800 1111. 📞
